entries.3a6086f218cdff25: Through consolidated subsidiaries in South Korea, the United States and China, it conducts internet mail-order sales to general consumers and wholesale sales to retailers. The amount is not separately disclosed.
entries.4c94fded65945368: This is the core business, planning, developing, manufacturing and selling mobile accessories centered on the smartphone case “iFace,” as well as cosmetics and gaming monitors. External sales for the fiscal year ended April 2026 were ¥20,095 million.
entries.4da83d9a11b6f2c5: It conducts wholesale sales of mobile accessories to major general merchandise chains and major consumer electronics chains, cosmetics to major general merchandise chains and drugstores, and gaming accessories to major consumer electronics chains and PC specialty stores. It also operates an internet wholesale site for EC businesses. The amount is not separately disclosed.

entries.bf6024ceeab28249: This business was engaged in developing and providing “Next Engine,” a cloud (SaaS) e-commerce platform for EC businesses. Because NE Co., Ltd. was excluded from consolidation through a share-distribution spin-off effective November 1, 2025, the business is not carried on as of the end of the current consolidated fiscal year; external sales of ¥1,978 million for the fiscal year ended April 2026 are results up to the date of deconsolidation.
